changelog: Fixed fullscreen going to a black screen with an endless reconnect loop for content that plays fine in the mini player. The fullscreen player's HTTP requests had no User-Agent set (defaulting to raw OkHttp's), while the mini player uses ExoPlayer's own built-in HTTP stack with its default User-Agent instead — some Cloudflare-fronted IPTV CDNs allow the latter but block the former. The fullscreen player now sends an ExoPlayer-style User-Agent too.
